verdicts.fix: engine: output '-hu', '-hā', '-hum' (no '·' separator when the preceding character is a tatweel/hyphen or nothing)
verdicts.reason: Confirmed: ⟶ 'ending -·hu (-hu)' etc. on the placard, and the same in grammar, days-51-60 and glossary-hand. The check should require prev.ch to be one of س ك د ت.
